description: Roman road-side settlement and multi-period ritual complex. Evidence for depositional activity from the Neolithic to the Roman period, a Roman enclosure on the site was considered strange and interpreted as a possible roadside shrine or temple, but with little evidence. There is however religious material from the site, including miniature martial weapons and curse tablets, suggesting there was a religious structure some where on the site, even if it isn't the identified enclosure. Occupation ends abruptly in the first half of the 4th CE.
